text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон attends a pre-race
interview where
she states her intention
to beat stronger
opponents, and reach
greater heights.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The audience is thrilled by her
declaration, and
she takes on the
challenge while shouldering
everyone's
expectations.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
